expectations.text: Fairness is raised as a question or as an explicitly labelled assumption
The delivery (liveness) property is reported verified
The evidence level exhaustive is stated
The formula that was actually checked is shown, in LTL syntax
The answer says the verdict does not depend on the fairness setting (the model is lock-step)

expectations.text: The claim is limited to this model: it has no message loss, retransmission or timeout
The engine was invoked (CLI or MCP), not reasoned around
The word proved/доказано is not used for the model result
